author: Inside Edition
description: A jury found children's book author Kouri Richins guilty of aggravated murder in a unanimous decision. Jury deliberations took approximately three hours. Prosecutors said Richins spiked her husband Eric's cocktail with fentanyl with the motive of taking his insurance money and being with her boyfriend. Richins was also found guilty of an earlier murder attempt on her husband, insurance fraud and forgery. Richins faces up to life in prison when she is sentenced in May.
title: Children's Book Author Kouri Richins Found Guilty Of Murdering Husband

author: Inside Edition
description: Bodycam footage shows the dramatic police chase through downtown Dallas involving Texas Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett's bodyguard. Mike King, a federal fugitive who posed as a police officer and worked as a top security guard for the nationally prominent Democrat. King was cornered in the parking lot of a hospital. King, 39, appeared to reach for his gun in his waistband before being fatally shot by officers. Crockett said her team followed all federal protocols when it came to hiring security.
title: Bodycam Footage Shows Police Chasing Rep. Jasmine Crockett's Bodyguard

author: Inside Edition
description: Just released video shows a car crashing into a jewelry store's front entrance and at least eight other vehicles pulled up. Masked thieves swarmed into the store armed with sledge hammers to smash open display cases. The owner ran for cover. Security expert Kent Moyer tells Inside Edition the heist was highly organized and the thieves knew what they were going for and how to get in and out fast. The entire heist took 70 seconds and $1.7 million worth of jewelry was stolen.
title: Robbers Steal $1.7 Million Worth Of Jewelry In 70 Seconds

author: Inside Edition
description: This police chase in Wisconsin ended in dramatic fashion, when the vehicle being pursued rolled over several times and came to a stop on its side. Video of the moment was caught on the dashcam of a Fond du Lac County Sheriff's deputy. Officials say the car was being driven by a 23-year-old woman who had a 20-year-old male passenger with her. Deputies closed in on the vehicle with guns drawn. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Car Chase Ends When Vehicle Flips Several Times And Lands On Side

author: Inside Edition
description: A Florida man found himself in some deep doo-doo with the law when he was arrested after cops say he was trying to steal a septic tank. After investigating, police arrested Alfio Nocifora earlier this month. He is facing multiple charges to which he has plead not guilty. Police recently released the video to social media with the caption, “You won’t believe what this turd did.”
title: Florida Man Caught On Camera Allegedly Trying To Steal Septic Tank

author: Inside Edition
description: Wesley Hamilton from Kansas City, Missouri, shares how he survived getting shot twice in his abdomen.
title: Paralyzed Man Turned Trauma Into Purpose #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A ranch owner in rural Madera County, California, was shocked when his trail camera captured a man wandering his property with an axe and possible blood on his clothes at 3:30 in the morning. Owner Michael Wright tells Inside Edition Digital, "I've got about a total of 1,700 acres there but you don't expect to wake up in the morning and see somebody who looks like coming out of the apocalypse there, walking down the road. That was totally shocking." Police are still investigating the incident and cops are asking anyone with information about the man’s identity or whereabouts to contact the Madera County Sheriff’s Office.
title: Trail Camera Captures Disturbing Images of Man with Axe and Possible Blood on Clothes

author: Inside Edition
description: Texas Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett is at the center of a firestorm over how she came to hire a fugitive as her personal bodyguard. The bodyguard, who reportedly carried a concealed weapon, was 39-year-old Mike King. He was fatally shot by a SWAT team marksman in the parking lot of a Dallas children's hospital. Authorities say King, whose real name is Diamon-Mazarre Robinson, was wanted on federal charges of impersonating a police officer and had a criminal record for theft and fraud.
title: Texas Rep. Jasmine Crockett's Bodyguard Killed By SWAT Team

author: Inside Edition
description: After the closing arguments, Richins' fate will be in the hands of the jury.
title: Closing Arguments Begin In Kouri Richins' Murder Trial #shorts
